name: Launch Day Hero
prompt: Create a polished launch-day campaign image for {product}, made for {audience}. Show the product as the clear hero with a confident {visual_style} art direction, generous negative space for a headline, and no readable text.

name: Weekend Offer Reel
prompt: A short, energetic commercial for {product}: open on an inviting close-up, reveal a bright weekend setting, and finish on a memorable product hero. Audience: {audience}. Keep the composition uncluttered and avoid legible lettering.

name: Seasonal Brand Story
prompt: Create a warm seasonal campaign visual for {brand}, featuring {product} in a setting inspired by {season}. Use a refined palette, natural light, and editorial composition for {audience}; leave breathing room and avoid readable text.

name: Unboxing Moment
prompt: A vertical creator-style video showing an authentic first look at {product}. Reveal the packaging, tactile details, and one satisfying use moment in a bright, relaxed space. Mood: {mood}. Keep the product recognizable and use no captions or logos beyond the supplied design.

name: Minimal Product Portrait
prompt: Photograph {product} as a premium studio product portrait on a {background}. Use soft directional lighting, crisp material detail, subtle grounded shadows, and a carefully balanced composition for {brand}. No extra objects or readable text.

name: Material Detail Loop
prompt: A smooth product-film shot of {product}, slowly rotating to reveal its {material_detail}. Use controlled studio reflections, a clean {background}, and a premium catalog finish. Keep the camera movement gentle and the item centered.

name: Everyday Use Scene
prompt: Show {product} being used naturally in a {location} by {audience}. Capture a candid, practical moment with believable proportions, soft daylight, and a modern lifestyle-photo feel. Keep the product visible and the scene free of legible text.

name: Creator Desk Setup
prompt: Create a vertical social post featuring {product} in a creator's workspace. Include a few purposeful desk objects, a lived-in but tidy feel, and {visual_style} lighting. Frame it for a quick mobile scroll with clear product visibility and no readable text.

name: Flavor in Motion
prompt: A lively short food commercial for {product}: fresh ingredients move into frame, the finished serving is revealed, and the camera settles on an appetizing hero shot. Style: {visual_style}. Use rich natural color and no readable labels.

name: Beauty Routine Close-Up
prompt: Create an elegant beauty campaign portrait for {product}, showing a calm everyday routine in a softly lit {location}. Emphasize natural skin texture, accurate packaging, and a fresh palette suited to {audience}. Avoid text overlays.

name: Small Business Spotlight
prompt: A human, welcoming social campaign for {brand}, centered on {product} and the people who make it. Set it in {location}, with documentary-inspired light, a candid moment, and room for a future caption. No readable text in the image.

name: Before the Reveal
prompt: Create a concise vertical teaser video for {product}. Begin with a close detail, use a smooth camera move to reveal the full item in a {background}, then hold a clean final hero frame. Mood: {mood}. Keep details faithful and avoid generated text.
